a.lede: Reddit’s r/opensource has barred AI-built, AI-focused, and AI-using projects under new rules announced October 24. The crackdown also imposes strict requirements on project age and contributors, while restrictions on non-English speakers have sparked further backlash. The debate puts the subreddit’s policy at odds with Linux’s acceptance of disclosed AI-assisted code contributions.
a.title: Reddit’s r/opensource bans AI-made and AI-focused projects, also bans non-English speakers

b.lede: New rules also shut out solo developers, fledgling projects, and anyone who doesn't speak English
b.title: Reddit's r/opensource bans AI slop, and quite a few humans for good measure
